camel_example: aliyun agentcore POST /workspaces/ws-2f5f9c5a8d0e4c3b/memorystores/customer-memory/memories --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body 'body={metadata={key=hiking}, referenceTime=2023-05-08T13:56:00+08:00, scope={agentId=agent-001, sessionId=session-001, userId=user-001}, messages=[{role=user, content=用户喜欢徒步旅行。}], text=用户喜欢徒步旅行。, sync=true}' --version 2026-08-04 --force
description_en: Extracts memories from text or messages, or directly writes organized memories. When the extract parameter is omitted or set to true, either the text parameter or non-empty messages must be provided. When the extract parameter is set to false, the memories parameter is used. When the sync parameter is omitted or set to true, the operation waits for processing to complete and returns memory references. An empty array is returned if no new memories are generated. When the sync parameter is set to false, a task ID is returned, and you can use GetMemoryTask to query the result. Direct writes do not create extraction tasks
description_zh: 支持从文本或消息中提取记忆，也支持直接写入整理好的记忆。extract 省略或为 true 时，text 与非空 messages 二选一；extract=false 时使用 memories。sync 省略或为 true 时等待处理完成并返回记忆引用，未产生新记忆时可返回空数组；sync=false 时返回任务标识，使用 GetMemoryTask 查询结果。直接写入不创建抽取任务
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore add-memories --workspace-id ws-2f5f9c5a8d0e4c3b --memory-store-name customer-memory --biz-body '{"metadata":{"key":"hiking"},"referenceTime":"2023-05-08T13:56:00+08:00","scope":{"agentId":"agent-001","sessionId":"session-001","userId":"user-001"},"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"用户喜欢徒步旅行。"}],"text":"用户喜欢徒步旅行。","sync":true}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddMemories

parameters.help_en: The name of the memory store
parameters.name: memory_store_name

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to extract memories. If omitted or set to true, memories are extracted from text or messages. If set to false, memories are directly written
fields.help_zh: 是否提取记忆。省略或 true 表示从 text 或 messages 提取；false 表示直接写入 memories
fields.name: extract

fields.help_en: The string key-value tags set by the caller. A maximum of 16 tags are supported. A key can be up to 64 Unicode characters in length, and a value can be up to 1,024 Unicode characters in length. Empty strings are allowed. Nested objects or arrays are not supported
fields.help_zh: 调用方设置的字符串键值标签，最多 16 项；键最多 64 个 Unicode 字符，值最多 1024 个 Unicode 字符，允许空字符串，不支持嵌套对象或数组
fields.name: metadata

fields.help_en: The content of the memory to be directly written. It cannot be empty and can be up to 32,000 UTF-8 bytes in length
fields.help_zh: 直接写入的记忆正文，不能为空，最多 32000 UTF-8 字节
fields.name: text

fields.help_en: The content type of the memory. Valid values: semantic for semantic memory, skill for skill, user_profile for user preference, and session_summary for session summary
fields.help_zh: 记忆内容类型：semantic 为语义记忆，skill 为技能，user_profile 为用户偏好，session_summary 为会话摘要
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The list of memories to be directly written when extract is set to false. The list can contain 1 to 100 memories. You cannot provide text, messages, referenceTime, or request-level metadata at the same time
fields.help_zh: extract=false 时直接写入的记忆列表，长度为 1～100；不能同时提供 text、messages、referenceTime 或请求级 metadata
fields.name: memories

fields.help_en: The reference time of the message in RFC 3339 format with a time zone. If omitted, the request-level referenceTime is used. If both are omitted, the time of the current request is used
fields.help_zh: 本条消息的参考时间，采用带时区的 RFC 3339 格式；省略时使用请求级 referenceTime，二者均省略时使用本次请求时间
fields.name: reference_time

fields.help_en: The list of messages. You must provide either text or messages, but not both. The list can contain 1 to 20 messages, and the total length of the content cannot exceed 32,000 UTF-8 bytes
fields.help_zh: 消息列表，与 Text 必须且只能提供一个；1～20 条，Content 合计不超过 32000 UTF-8 字节
fields.name: messages

fields.help_en: The string key-value metadata. A maximum of 16 keys are supported. A key can be up to 64 characters in length, and a value can be up to 1,024 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 字符串键值元数据；最多 16 个键，键最长 64 字符，值最长 1024 字符
fields.name: metadata

fields.help_en: The time reference point for the batch of messages or text. It uses the RFC 3339 format with a time zone and supports fractional seconds
fields.help_zh: 本批消息或文本的时间参考点；采用带时区的 RFC 3339 格式并支持小数秒
fields.name: reference_time

fields.help_en: The agent ID. The length is limited to 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes. It cannot contain a forward slash (/) or an asterisk (*)
fields.help_zh: Agent ID，长度限制 1 - 128 UTF-8 字节，不允许包含 / 或使用 *
fields.name: agent_id

fields.help_en: The session ID. The length is limited to 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes. It cannot contain a forward slash (/) or an asterisk (*)
fields.help_zh: Session ID，长度限制 1 - 128 UTF-8 字节，不允许包含 / 或使用 *
fields.name: session_id

fields.help_en: The business team ID defined by the caller. It cannot be empty when provided and can be up to 128 UTF-8 bytes in length
fields.help_zh: 由调用方定义的业务团队标识。提供时不能为空，最多 128 个 UTF-8 字节
fields.name: team_id

fields.help_en: The user ID. The length is limited to 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes. It cannot contain a forward slash (/) or an asterisk (*)
fields.help_zh: 用户 ID，长度限制 1 - 128 UTF-8 字节，不允许包含 / 或使用 *
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en: The write scope. UserId, AgentId, and SessionId are all optional
fields.name: scope

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronously wait for the memory extraction to complete. Default value: true
fields.help_zh: 是否同步等待记忆抽取完成，缺省为 true
fields.name: sync

fields.help_en: The text to be directly written. You must provide either text or messages, but not both. The text cannot exceed 32,000 UTF-8 bytes
fields.help_zh: 直接写入的文本，与 Messages 必须且只能提供一个；不超过 32000 UTF-8 字节
fields.name: text

memories.description_en: The memory references returned only when sync is set to true. An empty array is allowed. It is not returned together with taskId
memories.description_zh: 仅 sync=true 返回的记忆引用，允许空数组；不与 taskId 同时返回

taskId.description_en: The task ID returned only when sync is set to false. It is not returned together with memories
taskId.description_zh: 仅 sync=false 返回的任务 ID；不与 memories 同时返回

taskIds.description_en: The list of extraction task IDs. Multiple tasks may be returned when multiple rules are enabled. It is not returned for direct writes
taskIds.description_zh: 抽取任务标识列表；启用多条规则时可能返回多个任务。直接写入不返回

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
